benchmarks.name: GEO Citation · listwise Spearman (October 2026)
benchmarks.description: Citead original third-party inference study (arXiv:2610.38090v1), controlled retrieval: predict which of five supplied passages ten answer engines cite. Mean within-group Spearman correlation, average ranks for ties, constant predictions score zero; all-equal labels excluded. Exactly 1,220 engine-query groups from 229 queries. Five passages supplied together, 250 words per passage, six ordered citation levels and expectation of native probabilities, identical questions without prompt tuning. Raw signed rho in [-1,1], higher is better; fixed latent_scale=1 preserves correlation units. One primary metric from one study; no duplicate pointwise ablation, per-engine slices, top-1 or confidence metrics imported. The study concerns citation of provided passages, not live web retrieval or general decision accuracy. Published open-model repository identities are known, but tested weight commit hashes are not supplied.
